scenes.title: The valve controls holding and descent

vo.text: This hydraulic lift raises a heavy car using pressure in trapped oil.
vo.speak: This hydraulic lift raises a heavy car using pressure in trapped oil.

vo.text: A small input piston can multiply force because the lifting piston has a much larger area.
vo.speak: A small input piston can multiply force because the lifting piston has a much larger area.

vo.text: The pump pushes nearly incompressible oil into the lift cylinder.
vo.speak: The pump pushes nearly incompressible oil into the lift cylinder.

vo.text: Pressure spreads through the fluid and acts across the large piston.
vo.speak: Pressure spreads through the fluid and acts across the large piston.

vo.text: Force equals pressure times area, so that piston produces a powerful upward push.
vo.speak: Force equals pressure times area, so that piston produces a powerful upward push.

vo.text: As oil enters, the piston and lift arms rise together, carrying the car.
vo.speak: As oil enters, the piston and lift arms rise together, carrying the car.

vo.text: A closed valve traps the oil to hold the car; opening it allows a controlled descent.
vo.speak: A closed valve traps the oil to hold the car; opening it allows a controlled descent.

vo.text: So confined oil turns a compact pump into smooth, controlled lifting power.
vo.speak: So confined oil turns a compact pump into smooth, controlled lifting power.
